name: Ultimate Cannonbolt
abilities: Sphere transformation with a thicker, metallic, spiked shell
High-speed rolling with better traction, manoeuvrability and crushing power
Spike projection (per Eugene Son / DVD data)
weaknesses: No dedicated weakness documented on the wiki; presumed to share Cannonbolt's poor visibility and control while rolled up (not shown on-screen)
summary: The evolved Arburian Pelarota: Cannonbolt clad in hard metallic-blue armour whose studs become spikes in ball form, turning him into an unstoppable, radiation-proof wrecking ball.
traits: Always the last alien used in every episode he appears in
notableFeats: Held the radioactive P'Andor while Kevin forced his containment suit back on (Too Hot to Handle)
Nearly defeated Ultimate Aggregor inside the Perplexahedron (Perplexahedron)
Smashed Sunder to the ground and rescued Eunice (The Transmogrification of Eunice)
Punched Dr. Animo's mutant frog with a shock wave and beat Animo (It's Not Easy Being Gwen)

appearances.designNotes: Same build as UAF Cannonbolt but with hard metallic-blue skin; shell plates carry cylindrical studs (two per back segment, one on each shoulder, wrist and leg plate) that become spikes in the grey sphere form; two fangs; evolved Ultimatrix symbol on chest.

scoring.rationale: A thicker metallic shell and spikes make his ball form nearly unstoppable and he shrugs off P'Andor's radiation, so durability/defense lead; strong enough to slam Sunder and shock-wave a giant frog. Still a one-trick brawler with little range or versatility, and he was outplayed by Ultimate Aggregor.

notes: UA-only. Wiki has no Weaknesses section for this form; the weakness listed here is an inference flagged for QA.
'It's Not Easy Being Gwen' use was an off-screen activation (non-speaking).
Was originally scripted for Albedo's dream in 'Night of the Living Nightmare' but cut.

Sentient Ultimates storyline (UA S3, 'The Ultimate Sacrifice'): the six most-used Ultimate forms (Humungousaur, Swampfire, Spidermonkey, Big Chill, Cannonbolt, Echo Echo) gained sentience inside the Ultimatrix and demanded freedom; Ben offered his life, Azmuth freed them to their own world and reworked the Ultimatrix so Ultimates are 'empty shells' again.

Ultimate forms are artificial by-products of the Ultimatrix's evolutionary function (added by Albedo): the DNA is run through a simulated worst-case scenario over millions of theoretical years to force combat-oriented evolution. They are not natural Codon Stream species, and the Omniverse Omnitrix has no evolutionary function, so Ben never regains them after UA (Derrick J. Wyatt).
